items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: Oh yeah, Jim played a many parades. He's in the Cross the River.

ctx.x: I wish y'all could have seen little Jim playing the parades. He had a big, big drum up like that. Then you couldn't see him back up. You couldn't see him with the bass.
He had to look as he was behind the bass. And he played them parades too. Oh yeah, Jim played a many parades. He's in the Cross the River.
